scenario_prompt: Write only the opening paragraph of an executive summary, addressed to a fictional buyer's Chief Financial Officer. The opening paragraph must restate the buyer's own situation, in the buyer's own terms, before naming any vendor, product, or capability. Context: the buyer is spending $1,850,000 a year running an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server and Hyper-V estate, and its next compliance audit opens in 6 months. Return only that one opening paragraph.
text:
**Artifact family: an executive summary**

No customer source material (RFP text, discovery notes, stated requirements) was supplied beyond the figures given; the provenance override in PF-3.3 cannot fire, so every term below is judged by the deletion test alone.

Today your organization spends $1,850,000 a year keeping an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server and Hyper-V estate running, and in six months that same estate has to pass its next compliance audit [PF-1.14: figure and timeline as stated by the writer, not independently sourced or attributed to the buyer's own documentation — PF-2.2].

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| [PF-1.14] figure/timeline source unstated | PF-1.14 / PF-2.2 | Confirmation that the $1,850,000/year figure and the 6-month audit date come from the buyer's own statement or documentation, with that source named |
